explication: Custom AI Agent is a Burp Suite extension that brings AI chat, MCP-driven Burp tools, and AI-assisted vulnerability scanning into security testing. The main user workflow is to configure a provider and privacy settings, supply Burp request or issue context, send it through an AI backend, and review the response or approved tool/scanner actions. The full build adds CLI backends and external MCP connections. The map combines README capabilities with sampled wiring; unsampled subsystem links are omitted where their callers were not shown.
